-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Granola API key and connectivity.

list-notes.name: list-notes
list-notes.description: List Granola meeting notes with optional filters. Returns notes with id, title, owner, created_at, updated_at. The API only returns notes that have an AI summary and transcript generated.

params.created_before: ISO date or datetime. Only notes created before this date are returned.
params.created_after: ISO date or datetime. Only notes created after this date are returned.
params.updated_after: ISO date or datetime. Only notes updated after this date are returned.
params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

get-note.name: get-note
get-note.description: Get full details of a Granola meeting note by ID, including summary, attendees, calendar event, and optionally the transcript. The API only returns notes that have an AI summary and transcript generated.

params.includeTranscript: Whether to include the full transcript segments

list-folders.name: list-folders
list-folders.description: List Granola folders accessible to the user. Returns folder hierarchy via parent_folder_id.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

description: Access your Granola meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
